# History and both old/invalid attempt log selections enforce object ownership.
# Token outputs require an explicitly private fixture parent under any umask.
private-workdir
env SKYGO_TOKEN=
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add bob --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue bob --auth-file $AUTH --output bob.token --expires-in 24h
server start
retry-task task.json once 1
skygo --token-file alice.token --json run -f task.json --request-id own-retry --wait
job-id JOB
history failed succeeded
! stdout 'sky(go)?_[0-9a-f]{32}_'
! stderr 'sky(go)?_[0-9a-f]{32}_'
! skygo --token-file bob.token --json jobs get $JOB
stderr '^not_found: '
cp stderr foreign.err
! skygo --token-file bob.token --json jobs get 00000000000000000000000000000000
cmp stderr foreign.err
! skygo --token-file bob.token jobs logs $JOB --attempt 1
cmp stderr foreign.err
! skygo --token-file bob.token jobs logs $JOB --attempt 99
cmp stderr foreign.err
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $JOB --attempt 1
stdout '^attempt one\n$'
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $JOB --attempt 2
stdout '^attempt two\n$'
server stop
! stderr .
